purpose: Help a volunteer document a walking-access barrier without making an engineering decision.

place_and_users.place: Conceptual audit between Zhichun Road and Dazhongsi
excluded_or_at_risk_users: people who do not consent to route logging

trigger: A participant actively starts a single accompanied audit or uses a paper form.
consent_and_notice: Explain the purpose and deletion path before the audit; participation is optional.
retention_and_deletion: Delete raw route traces after field verification; retain an anonymous barrier record.
model_and_limits: Clustering may group reports but cannot select an engineering option or approve a connection.

human_owner.contact_path: proposed staffed desk, phone and paper address
human_owner.final_decision: transport, rail, landscaping and accessibility professionals

explanation: Show how a report was grouped and whether it was field-verified.
appeal: A participant can correct or withdraw a report through staffed, phone or paper channels.
repair_sla: Acknowledge the report and publish a verification status; timing is negotiated before a real pilot.
non_ai_fallback: Staffed accompanied walk, printed map and paper barrier form.

public_value_metric.measure: verified barrier closure by user role, not interaction count
public_value_metric.time_window: baseline, limited pilot and adopt-or-exit review
public_value_metric.negative_result: no safe improvement, new exclusion, or unmaintainable intervention

stop_and_rollback.rollback_action: stop digital collection, remove temporary digital layer, retain verified paper findings
